name: Optimal Recovery of a Promised Antimatroid Basic Word
statement: Let an antimatroid be represented by monotone Boolean precedence formulas of total length $N$, and suppose an unknown total order $\pi$ is promised to be one of its basic words. With an oracle that compares two ground-set elements, $\pi$ can be recovered in $O(N+\log|\operatorname{BW}(\mathcal A)|)$ time using $O(\log|\operatorname{BW}(\mathcal A)|)$ comparisons. Thus the information-theoretic comparison bound is attained; the result does not claim that the entire state graph can be listed in this time.
proof: This is the cited optimal antimatroid-sorting theorem for the precedence-formula representation.
